summary: Climber on the West Ridge Indirect approach of Little Bear Peak knocked down a long fall by a dislodged large rock; suffered fatal injuries despite a Black Hawk hoist and intensive lifesaving efforts
location: Little Bear Peak, West Ridge Indirect
responding_agency: Alamosa Volunteer SAR, CO Army National Guard, DFPC Canon Helitack, REACH71, Colorado SAR, Alamosa County Sheriff
notes: Victim was in a party; other hikers guided down by AVSAR by 6pm | Run 786 merge: Alamosa Citizen SLV Outdoor Report (week of July 8, 2026) 'AVSAR MISSION ON LITTLE BEAR' corroborates 2026-06-27 West Ridge Indirect rockfall fatality (AVSAR helo insert, COARNG Black Hawk hoist, REACH 71; victim died shortly after).
